Hello!
I'm happy to announce that Summer Meetings is now available!
The production went far better than I expected. I believe it's better to release the game earlier than to delay it.
As always, let me know what you like, what you don't? Which solutions would you like to see in my next game, which not? Do you miss anything?
I'm waiting for your opinions :)

If you own all my previous games, you can have an additional discount when completing the bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8186/Love__Comedy/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140140/Summer_Meetings/

Special thanks to [b]Alexander Slous[/b], who volunteered in editing/proofreading!

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

PS: My next project will surprise everyone (including myself).

notes.title: Summer Meetings - New Project!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/b03a5730787021e9b3f6d2b948b699d161670b61.jpg[/img]

Hello!
I'm happy to announce my new project - Summer Meetings.
In contrast to my previous titles, it won't be a pure romantic comedy. Depending on your choices (there are over 50 in one playthrough) you can get into a drama. The game can end in multiple ways, even ones you won't expect.

This project is rather experimental, especially in the way you can start a route... Actually, you can start a few at the same time. Consequences are another subject.

There's a high chance that the game will be released this year :)

Wishlist today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140140/Summer_Meetings/

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

PS: If you have any questions, feel free to write in Community Hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1140140/discussions/

notes.title: 1.0.1 - English fix
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you very much for the feedback about the game.
I heard there were some issues with English, although I hired editor/proofreader.

Special thanks to [b]Alexander Slous[/b], who volunteered to check the script.

Additionally, I made visible from the start option to color already seen text (originally this option was visible after finishing a route).

The Polish version had only minor changes.

Let me know if there's anything else.

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

PS: I also took a look at the graphical issues some of you have and... Looks like I can't fix that, sadly. The engine I'm using wasn't made to handle so many animations, so when an animated character comes in/out the scene it causes glitches.

PPS: I hope to surprise you a little with the next project. More info in the next months.

notes.title: Courage for a Kiss - NEW GAME IN PROGRESS!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/5013309c05ca82199d3b04d9a0625e35d4ea45be.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/960590/Courage_for_a_Kiss
I'm happy to announce that I'm working on new title - Courage for a Kiss!
It will be a romantic comedy story about high school students working on stage play.

Before, and during planning, I read all your reviews on both previous games and comments under let's plays. I've added what you liked and were asking for:
[list][*]CHOICES!
- Several visibly different choices affecting the story and relationships with heroines!
[*]MORE STORY!
- Game will be much longer than previous ones, about 3x more content.
[/list]

What else can you expect in this game?
[list]
[*]Systems/mechanics that were well-received in previous games, updated and modified, as well as some new solutions improving your experience and immersion;
[*]As you might notice, there's "Mature content description" with this game. Let me know if you like the idea;
[*]And of course, new, interesting characters!
[/list]

Opening movie, gameplay trailer and more screens will appear as the development progresses. Relase date will also change as the work will be closer to completion.

Don't forget to add the game to the wishlist and follow!
If you have any first impressions or questions, let me know, write a post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/960590/discussions/]Community Hub[/url]!

On the release day, game will be available in English and Polish.

Merry Christmass and a Happy New Year!
Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

https://store.steampowered.com/app/960590/Courage_for_a_Kiss
